#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 750

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(statmod)

#-----------------------------
# WALD kernel function
#-----------------------------
wald_kernel <- function(height, tv, wind,
                        kappa = 0.3,
                        max_dist = 5) {
  
  sigma2 <- kappa * height
  
  lambda <- (height / sqrt(sigma2))^2
  mu <- (height * wind) / tv
  
  x <- seq(0.001, max_dist, by = 0.01)
  
  density <- sqrt(
    lambda / (2 * pi * x^3)
  ) * exp(
    -(lambda * (x - mu)^2) /
      (2 * mu^2 * x)
  )
  
  data.frame(
    distance = x,
    density = density,
    mu = mu,
    lambda = lambda,
    LDD = qinvgauss(0.95, mean = mu, shape = lambda)
  )
}

#-----------------------------
# UI
#-----------------------------
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("WALD Long-Distance Seed Dispersal Simulator"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    
    sidebarPanel(
      
      h4("Species 1"),
      
      sliderInput(
        "height1",
        "Seed Release Height (m)",
        min = 0.05,
        max = 2,
        value = 0.6,
        step = 0.01
      ),
      
      sliderInput(
        "tv1",
        "Terminal Velocity (m/s)",
        min = 0.05,
        max = 2,
        value = 0.5,
        step = 0.01
      ),
      
      sliderInput(
        "wind1",
        "Wind Speed (m/s)",
        min = 0.1,
        max = 10,
        value = 2,
        step = 0.1
      ),
      
      hr(),
      
      checkboxInput(
        "compare",
        "Add second species",
        value = FALSE
      ),
      
          
      conditionalPanel(
        
        condition = "input.compare == true",
        
        h4("Species 2"),
        
        sliderInput(
          "height2",
          "Seed Release Height (m)",
          min = 0.05,
          max = 2,
          value = 0.75,
          step = 0.01
        ),
        
        sliderInput(
          "tv2",
          "Terminal Velocity (m/s)",
          min = 0.05,
          max = 2,
          value = 0.5,
          step = 0.01
        ),
        
        sliderInput(
          "wind2",
          "Wind Speed (m/s)",
          min = 0.1,
          max = 10,
          value = 2,
          step = 0.1
        )
        
      )
      
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      
      plotOutput("kernelPlot", height = "500px"),
      
      checkboxInput(
        "autoscale_y",
        "Auto-scale y-axis",
        value = FALSE
      ),
      
      hr(),
      
      tableOutput("params")
      
    )
  )
  
)

#-----------------------------
# Server
#-----------------------------
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  kernels <- reactive({
    
    plant1 <- wald_kernel(
      input$height1,
      input$tv1,
      input$wind1
    )
    
    plant1$plant <- "Species 1"
    
    if (input$compare) {
      
      plant2 <- wald_kernel(
        input$height2,
        input$tv2,
        input$wind2
      )
      
      plant2$plant <- "Species 2"
      
      rbind(plant1, plant2)
      
    } else {
      
      plant1
      
    }
    
  })
  
  output$kernelPlot <- renderPlot({
    
    p <- ggplot(
      kernels(),
      aes(
        x = distance,
        y = density,
        color = plant
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "Species 1" = "black",
          "Species 2" = "blue"
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Dispersal Distance (m)",
        y = "Probability Density",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14)
    
    if (!input$autoscale_y) {
      p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.7))
    }
    p
    
  })
  
  output$params <- renderTable({
    
    k <- kernels()
    
    unique(
      k[, c("plant", "mu", "lambda", "LDD")]
    )
    
  }, digits = 3)
  
}

#-----------------------------
# Launch app
#-----------------------------
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
